name: mfe-composition-benchmark
description: Performance comparison of micro frontend composition strategies (Module Federation, Single-SPA, React Server Components) on an identical e-commerce app backed by FakeStore API.

scripts.a:dev: concurrently -n shell,home,plp,pdp,cart "npm run dev -w a-shell" "npm run dev -w a-home" "npm run dev -w a-plp" "npm run dev -w a-pdp" "npm run dev -w a-cart"
scripts.a:build: npm run build -w a-home -w a-plp -w a-pdp -w a-cart -w a-shell
scripts.a:start: concurrently -n shell,home,plp,pdp,cart "npm run serve -w a-shell" "npm run serve -w a-home" "npm run serve -w a-plp" "npm run serve -w a-pdp" "npm run serve -w a-cart"
scripts.b:dev: concurrently -n root,navbar,home,plp,pdp,cart "npm run dev -w b-root-config" "npm run dev -w b-navbar" "npm run dev -w b-home" "npm run dev -w b-plp" "npm run dev -w b-pdp" "npm run dev -w b-cart"
scripts.b:build: npm run build -w b-navbar -w b-home -w b-plp -w b-pdp -w b-cart -w b-root-config
scripts.b:start: concurrently -n root,navbar,home,plp,pdp,cart "npm run serve -w b-root-config" "npm run serve -w b-navbar" "npm run serve -w b-home" "npm run serve -w b-plp" "npm run serve -w b-pdp" "npm run serve -w b-cart"
